property_summary: Whenever withdraw(value) is called by a non-owner, it reverts unless value is 0 and the contract balance is at least 0, in which case it still reverts because onlyOwner is applied; but since owner is the test contract, a non-owner is any other caller, and the test contract cannot make c.owner() differ from itself, so the rule must account for the possibility that the test contract is the owner and thus withdrawals succeed when value <= balance.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `withdraw(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
